subject: QuantumHealth renewal + capacity increase — MSA & Order Form coordination
body:
From: Elaine Park <epark@quantumhealth.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Gardner <tgardner@quantumhealth.com>, procurement@quantumhealth.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity bump for Q2 — need MSA/order adjustments

Hi Olga,

Hope you're well. We're approaching the end of our current term (ends 2027-04-30) and we want to renew for another 12 months but with two changes: 1) increase committed GPU capacity by 40% for inference (projected to start 2027-06-01), and 2) update data residency clause for our new EU customer segment.

Can you share an updated order form and any MSA amendment language you typically use for capacity increases? Procurement would like to see redlines and a sample SOW for the capacity start date.

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Partnerships
QuantumHealth

----------
From: olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Park <epark@quantumhealth.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump for Q2 — need MSA/order adjustments

Hi Elaine — great to hear from you and congrats on the EU expand. We can absolutely support the renewal + capacity increase.

Quick plan:
- I'll attach a redlined order form (v3) and a marked-up MSA amendment for your legal team to review.
- Rafael (copied) will confirm pricing/discount for the upsell and alignment to your committed tier.
- Marcus (legal) will propose clean amendment language for the residency clause so it's shareable with procurement.
- If procurement needs to push a PO or have specific DocuSign routing, loop in Lauren (finance) and we can expedite.

Next steps: I'll send the attachments and proposed DocuSign envelope by EOD. Could you confirm whether the EU residency requirement is limited to logs/audit data vs. all inference inputs/outputs? That affects the amendment scope.

Warmly,

— Olga Petrov
Senior Account Director | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: QuantumHealth_Renewal_OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf, QH-MSA-amendment-markup.docx

----------
From: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Park <epark@quantumhealth.com>, olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump for Q2 — need MSA/order adjustments

Elaine — Rafael here. Thanks for the heads up. Pricing summary for the 40% capacity add:
- Current committed monthly tokens: 150M -> New committed: 210M (40% increase).
- Effective term: 12 months starting 2027-05-01 (we can align billing to ship date).
- Volume discount: we'll apply the next tier discount of 7.5% across committed tokens for the first 9 months; months 10–12 revert to baseline unless we hit the next commit threshold.

I'll include a clear line item on the order form showing the bump vs. overage rates. If QuantumHealth wants a firm start date of 2027-06-01, we can set a pro-rated billing stub for May.

Question for procurement: do you require Redwood to sign a separate addendum for data residency, or is an MSA amendment acceptable?

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com

----------
From: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
To: procurement@quantumhealth.com, Elaine Park <epark@quantumhealth.com>, olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump for Q2 — need MSA/order adjustments

Hi Elaine / Procurement team — Marcus from Legal. I've reviewed EU residency language in the proposed MSA amendment. Two options depending on your needs:

1) Narrow scope (logs & audit data only): quick toggle — add a new Section 5.4.a that mandates EU region for logs, audit trails, and telemetry. This is operationally feasible and low friction.

2) Full data residency (inputs/outputs + logs): larger lift — would require contractual guarantees around where inference input/output tensors are persisted (ephemeral caching vs. long-term storage), updated SOC controls, and likely revising our subprocessor list. This will take one more week to finalize and will require sign-off from our security/compliance team.

I've attached a marked-up amendment (QH-MSA-amendment-markup.docx) with both redline paths. If procurement prefers Option 1, we can turn this around same-day. If Option 2, please expect an internal security review (we'll target completion by 2027-03-24).

Also looping in Lauren from Finance in case procurement wants specific invoice or PO handling for the pro-rated period.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Corporate Counsel | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

----------
From: procurement@quantumhealth.com
To: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, Elaine Park <epark@quantumhealth.com>, olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump for Q2 — need MSA/order adjustments

Marcus / Olga / Rafael — thanks for the options. QuantumHealth prefers Option 1 (logs & audit only) to start; we'll revisit full residency if usage patterns require it. Procurement needs the following before we issue PO:
- Clean redline PDF of the MSA amendment reflecting Option 1
- Updated order form with pro-rated line for May and explicit start date of 2027-06-01 for capacity change
- Copy of the current SOC 2 report (or a link) and list of subprocessors for the MSA appendix (if different)

We will sign via DocuSign. Please route to procurement@quantumhealth.com and add Tom Gardner as signer for PO approval.

Thanks — Procurement Team
procurement@quantumhealth.com

----------
From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: procurement@quantumhealth.com, olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump for Q2 — need MSA/order adjustments

Hi Tom / procurement team — Lauren from Finance. We're preparing the DocuSign envelope and the clean redline PDF. Delivery plan: 

- Today (2027-03-22): send clean redline PDF + updated order form that shows pro-rated May stub and June 1 capacity effective date.
- DocuSign envelope to Tom Gardner and Elaine Park for signature today; payment terms remain Net 30 unless you request a change.
- SOC 2 link: https://redwoodinference.com/docs/soc2-2026-report (read-only). Subprocessor list attached in the DocuSign package.

If procurement issues the PO number, include it in the DocuSign reference field and reply-all with the PO. Otherwise, we'll push to signature and notify Rafael once complete.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

----------
On Mon, 22 Mar 2027 at 15:45:00 -0700 Tom Gardner <tgardner@quantumhealth.com> wrote:

Thanks Lauren / Olga / Marcus — we received the DocuSign and redlines. PO 789234 will be sent to procurement@redwoodinference.com after signature. We prefer Net 30. ETA signatures by end of day.

— Tom Gardner
VP, Procurement | QuantumHealth

[DocuSign envelope sent: https://www.docusign.net/transaction/ABC123456789]
